# iran-bourse-mcp

> Open-source, read-only MCP server giving AI agents clean Tehran Stock Exchange (TSETMC) and Codal data: quotes, order book and queues, tick-by-tick trades, real vs legal money flow, major shareholders, filings, funds NAV, commodity and energy exchanges. 40 tools. Works with any MCP client (Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, Goose, OpenCode, Kiro, Qwen Code, JetBrains, Amp) and, via a shell command, with agents that have no MCP support. Needs a machine in Iran for TSETMC/Codal access.

## Docs
- [Install guide for AI agents](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/docs/llms-install.md): step-by-step setup you can follow
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md): every tool and parameter
- [Data sources and quirks](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/docs/DATA_SOURCES.md): endpoints used and traps handled
- [Real example outputs](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/docs/EXAMPLES.md): one live response per tool
- [Persian user guide](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.fa.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp/blob/main/benchmarks/README.md): tokens, requests, time and accuracy with and without the server
